items.headline: Giannis stuffs the sheet in a Heat jersey — triple-double in a 145-125 rout
items.body: In case you missed the summer blockbuster, the Greek Freak plays for Miami now — and he looked right at home Friday, piling up 31 points, 18 rebounds and 10 assists as the Heat buried the Pacers 145-125. Davion Mitchell chipped in a 15-and-11 to keep the engine humming.
items.say: Did you catch that Giannis is on the Heat now? He just dropped a triple-double and they scored 145.

items.headline: Cooper Flagg goes for 33 as the Mavs edge Houston 116-111
items.body: The No. 1 pick is already must-watch. Dallas's teenage phenom poured in 33 points, and with Kyrie Irving adding 35 the Mavs held off the Rockets in a back-and-forth Friday thriller. The 2026 rookie class keeps turning heads.
items.say: Cooper Flagg already looks like the real deal — 33 points and the Mavs got the win.

items.headline: Chef Curry cooks the Lakers — 8 threes in a 112-95 Warriors win
items.body: Steph Curry splashed eight threes to send Golden State past the Lakers, spoiling a 37-point night from Luka Dončić. Even a quiet-by-his-standards shooting slump never lasts long when Curry gets going from deep.
items.say: Curry hit eight threes against the Lakers last night — the guy is still unreal from range.

items.headline: It's grand-final day in Bucharest — FURIA vs. Nemiga for $450K
items.body: The $1.25M PGL Masters Bucharest is down to its last two: Brazil's FURIA against the underdog story of the week, Nemiga. It's a best-of-five for the trophy and the lion's share of the prize pool — the kind of CS2 Saturday worth clearing the calendar for.
items.say: The Counter-Strike final is today — FURIA against a total underdog in Nemiga. Could be a classic.

items.headline: A juicy Saturday in England — Chelsea host Manchester United
items.body: The Premier League rolls on with a proper marquee fixture: Chelsea vs. Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, one of the English game's oldest rivalries. Plenty of other games dot the card too, so there's football on all afternoon.
items.say: Chelsea–United is on today — always a spicy one. Catching any of the Premier League this weekend?

items.headline: Queens of the Stone Age are back — 'Perfecth' is finally out
items.body: After all the teasing, the band's ninth album 'Perfecth' landed Friday, and early reviews are warm — critics are calling it their most stripped-down, human record in years. The star-studded 'Where The Goth Girls At?' video is the perfect spooky-season appetizer.
items.say: The new Queens of the Stone Age album dropped — that 'Where The Goth Girls At?' video is wild.

items.headline: What's your favorite scary movie? 'Scream' is back in theaters
items.body: Perfect timing: Paramount has brought Wes Craven's 1996 slasher classic back to the big screen for its 30th anniversary, landing in select theaters for Halloween weekend. Ghostface, Sidney, that opening phone call — it still holds up.
items.say: They put the original 'Scream' back in theaters for its 30th — feels like the ultimate Halloween watch.

items.headline: Happy Halloween — cue up 'Thriller'
items.body: It's the big night. Whether you're handing out candy, chaperoning trick-or-treaters, or just hiding from the doorbell with a bowl of fun-size bars, there's one video that basically is Halloween — Michael Jackson's 14-minute 'Thriller,' still the gold standard 40-plus years on.
items.say: Happy Halloween! Any big plans tonight — or just you, the candy bowl and 'Thriller' on loop?
